tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu shrī ye/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dga' mkha' mnyam dpe med bde bar gtso/ /zab gsal dbyer med mi shigs rdo rje'i sku/ /lhun grub bsam pa ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don/ / sgrub mdzad bla ma lhag pa'i lhar btud nas/ /de nyid mchod pa'i rim pa gang*/ /rgyud gzhung bla ma'i man ngag ltar/ / sems ni snying rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /mdo tsam rnam par dbye bar bya/ / 'dir phyi rol gyi mchod pa dang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang 'brel bar mchod chog gi rim pa ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal chog gi skabs ji lta bar mchod pa'i lha mo spro ba rnams byas la/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i cho ga dngos la/ yang mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ bla na med pa dang*/ de kho na nyid dang*/ nyer mkho'i mchod pa ste drug las/ dang po la chu dang*/ nyer spyod sogs dang/ 'dod yon dang*/ rin chen sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis kyi yo byad dbul ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /oṃ mañdzu badz+ra de wa tsakra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ra āḥhri pra wa ra sat+ka r+thaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos la/ yon chab zhes pa'i tshab tu/ zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ zhes par/ pād+yeṃ/ zhal bsil dang*/ añtsa ma naṃ/ gsang gtor dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen tu bstan pa dang*/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje kha tshur kha 'og tu phyogs pa'i mtheb mdzub brkam pa'i tshul gyis me tog len tshul byas ste/

steng du kha phye la mthe'u chung nas rim pas sor mo lhag ma rnams 'brel ba dang*/ de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ steng nas blangs ste/ 'og tu phyogs pas 'grol ba dang*/ lag pa g.yon pa dung chos 'dzin pa'i tshul las/ g.yas pas ku sha bzung ste 'thor ba'i tshul rnams so/ / gnyis pa ni/ oṃ lha yi me tog dam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig / 'di la spro na/ oṃ āḥmañdzu badz+ra badz+ra dhik/ rat+na dh-ik/ a ro l̥k / pradz+nyā dhṛk /mo hā ra ti/ dwe ṣa ra ti/ rā ga ra ti/ badz+ra ra ti/ rū pa badz+ra/ shap+ta badz+ra/ gan+dha badz+ra/ rā sa badz+rā/ spār+sha badz+rā/ dharma dhā tu badz+rā/ ya mān+ta kṛt/ prādz+nyan+ta kṛtra/ pad+mān+ta kṛtra/ bi ga nān+ta kṛtra puṣ+pe pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du sbyar ba'am/ yang na sngags phreng ltar las/ sngags so so'i mjug tu/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis dbul/ de tsam mi lcogs na/ mchod yon sogs kyis rigs 'gre bar byas te/ puṣ+pe sogs su 'don pa bsgyur/ de bzhin du/ bdug pos/ dhu pe/ snang gsal a lo ke/ dri mchog /gan+de/ zhal zas/ nai d+ya/ rol mo/ shap+ta/ gsum pa la/ thabs kyis mchod pa dang*/ shes rab kyi mchod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ / de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ / 'bul sngags gzhan rnams gong bzhin la/ u pa ya rū pa zhes 'don pa spo/ sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshul brnyes pa'o/ /u pa ya shap+ta/ dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ / de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /u pa ya gan dhe/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/

/de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /u pa ya tā sa/ /reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /u pa ya spār+sha/ /gzugs sgra ro la sogs pa la/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po btus pa'o/ / u pa ya dharmā dhā tu/ / gnyis pa ni/ phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs/ /de bzhin gzugs la dbye ba gsum/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /sa snying la ni dbul bar bya/ / pradz+nyā rū pa/ yang dag glu dang brjod bral dbyangs/ /de bzhin sgra la dbye ba gsum/ /sgra yi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /phyag rdor la ni dbul bar bya/ /pradz+nyā shap+ta/ ga bur a ka dzā ti sogs/ /de bzhin dri la dbye ba gsum/ /dri'i rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /nam snying la ni dbul bar bya/ /pradz+nyā gan+dhe/ 'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang*/ /ro drug de bzhin dbye ba gsum/ /ro yi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la ni dbul/ /pradz+nyā rā sa/ rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyor/ /'khyud dang gos sogs dbye ba gsum/ /reg bya'i rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /sgrib sel la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /pradz+nyā spār+she/ phyi yi chos rnams 'di dag kun/ /brtags pa dang ni ma brtags pa/ /chos dbyings rdo rjer yang dag bkug /'jam pa'i rdo rje la ni dbul/ pradz+nyā dharma dhā tu/ bzhi pa ni/ dngos dang yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zhing 'di 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin rer bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /tsakra rat+na/ zhing 'di nor bu rin chen gyi/ / sogs/ ma ṇi rat+na/ btsun mo= s+t+ri rat+na/ blon po= pu ru ṣa rat+na/ glang po= hasti rat+na/ rta mchog= a shwa rat+na/ khyim bdag= /gṛ ha pa ti rat+na/ gnyis pa ni/

g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang*/ /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i lpags pa dang*/ / yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang*/ / dga' 'gyur brtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /gang 'dod blta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim/ /thags bzang bsreg bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos/ /chu la mi bying ngal dub med pa'i lham/ / nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag 'bul/ / sap+ta u pa rat+na/ lnga pa la gnyis las/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ / bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil/ /dge ba'i yo byad mnga' ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /shrī btas+ya/ tshig thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la/ gser gyis 'khor lo mu khyud can/ /tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar/ /he ma tsakra/ gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ /bde ba'i yo byad mchog phul ba/ / tshā traṃ ka /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yis/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phul ba ltar/ /dh+wa dza/ re ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa'i/ /bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar/ /ni dhi gha ṭa/ skyon gyis ma gos 'dam skyes pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po phul ba ltar/ /pad+ma snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi/ /'bud dung dkar po phul ba ltar/ /shaṃ kha/ na bza' gser gyi nya ris can/ /bde ba'i yo byad phul ba ltar/ /ka na ka maras+ya/ gnyis pa rdzas brgyad kyis mchod pa ni/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ / bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /maṅga la aṣ+ta dra bya/ gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi spyi bo'i thad ka nas 'thor zhing*/ dpal ldan rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*/ 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ bi ma la gup+ta/

rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lots+tsha ba dar ma grags/ snang kha'u ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma kirti shrī/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyugapaṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ mkhas pa kun dga' tshe 'phel/ ral gsal zla ba mgon po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan ste dbang dka' gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam dbyangs ye shes zhabs/ /mar me mdzad bzang kun snying tha ga na/ /shan+ti pa dang ta shad+dh+ra rin chen bzang*/ / skyang po chos blo dge gshes skyabs seng dang*/ /rdo rje sra brtan jo sras dkon mchog 'bar/ /dge bshes dbang rin phu thang ston shaka dang*/ /rong pa chos mgon lots+tsha mchog ldan pa/ /dpal ldan seng ge bu ston chos kyi rje/ /gzhon nu bsod nams ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*/ /kun dga' bzang po gug ge paṇ+ḍi ta/ /glo bo mkhan chen rje btsun grol mchog zhabs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug kun dga'i mtshan can ste/ /lung brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / yang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes mar me mdzad bzang po/ / 'jam dpal grags pa bde ba chen po yi ge pa/ /kar+ṇa pa dang dz+nyā na shrī mi tra dang*/ /ba liṃ ā tsar+ya dang gnyos lo yon tan grags/ /rdo rje bla ma jo sras dpal seng grags pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas ras chen ston lung ye 'bar chos 'od dang*/ /'phags 'od bu ston byang chub rtse mo grags rgyal ba/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal mon rdzong nyi zlar grags pa gnyis/ /nam mkha' rin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/

/dbang rgyud man ngag gsum ldan bla ma rnams la 'bul/ / brgyud pa'i yi ge 'ga' zhig ltar na/ mar me mdzad bzang po'i rjes su sman pa'i zhabs/ ce lu pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ ka ma la gu h+ya/ mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan/ sras dz+nyā na rā dza/ de la gnyos lo 'byung pos dbang dang man ngag tsam thob nas brgyud zhu long ma byung bas/ rgya gar du byon ces snang bas/ de bzhin du ded kyang rung ngo*/ /gnyos lugs brgyud pa snga ma de lta na yang*/ bde ba chen po ni ye shes zhabs kyi dngos slob du snang bas/ bar gyi bla ma gnyis po de ma bcug kyang rung bar sems so/ / 'jam rdor jo bo lugs sam 'jig rten dbang phyug ltar na/ shān+ti pa dang dpal ldan a ti sha /'gar dge lha btsun byang 'od wal pa dang*/ /lcags ri ba dang ljing bu thang stod pa/ /zhang ye bzo pa don grub bar thang pa/ /dar ma shākya bsod dbang lo mchog dang*/ /gzhon 'od grags chen 'phags 'od bu ston rje/ /thugs sras lo tsā 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal dang*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mkhyen rab mchog grub dang*/ /spyan snga lha dbang spyan snga ngag dbang dang*/ /byams pa chos 'byor rnam rgyal rin chen dang*/ /ngag dbang rnam rgyal rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / ces dang rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor mi bskyod pa'i brgyud pa ltar na/ 'jam dbyangs ye shes zhabs dang thugs sras bzhi/ /sman zhabs sangs rgyas dpal dang rdo rje gdan/ /sau ri pa dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas dang*/ /dge 'byung stobs bcu rdo rje dpal dang ni/ /chos 'byung dpal dang sangs rgyas grags pa dang*/ /rin chen grags pa rā ti gup+ta dang*/ /grub chen zhi ba pan grub rnam gnyis te/ /ngo mtshar bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / ces bya'o/ / oṃ āḥmañdzu badz+ra maṃ hūṃ/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ sogs so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/

rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud te/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dgos kyi chos skyong yod na/ de dang de'i snying po'i mthar yi ge 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa bskyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu bdun/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du mchod par 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang*/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag/grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i/ sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim par gyur cig /bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni rtse bas nyer dgongs ste/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ āḥpañtsa a mri ta pu dzi te hūṃ/ gsum pa ni/ bud med gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa ni/ /dri dang me tog phreng brgyan te/ /yon tan ske rags mā ma ki /shes rab can gyis byin rlabs la/ /'khor lo'i dbus su mchod par bya/ /rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs mchog gi brgyan/ /dngos grub rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams kun la dbul bar bya/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma la/

/'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs//'pho med bde ba mngon du 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ / sgrub thabs bshad pa ltar/ /dngos sam ye shes rig ma la rjes su chags pa tsam ste/ oṃ sarbā ta thā ga a nu ra ga na badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa ni/ thabs shes snyoms par sbyor las byung*// byang chub sems spros de bzhin gshegs/ /ma lus nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla med mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ āḥ.a nurta ra pu dzi te hūṃ/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar phyung*/ /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūṃ/ rnam par rtog pa kun gyi tshogs//lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /nges par bsreg pa de'i spos/ / thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /dhu pe/ yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung*/ /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /a lo ke /bde ba chen po'i nam mkha' gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*/ /de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa ni/ /thugs kyi= gan+de/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i phyir du mchod par bgyi/ /nai we t+ya/ rdo rje pad+mar yang dag bskyod/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mi shigs sgra/ /thugs kyishap+ta/ rgod dang sgeg dang rtse 'jo ni/ /sna tshogs kyis ni sems dgar byed/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gang dag

/thugs kyi= mahā su khaṃ/ lnga pa ni/ de kho na nyid bsgom bzhin du/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ / bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ / drug pa ni/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob thog/oṃ mañdzu badz+ra sogs gong bzhin la/ badz+ra wa s+t+ra ye/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa ni/ / ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /me tog ka ni ka ra dang*/ / ma li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog ka ra wi ra dang*/ /lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam du/ /gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /mchod rten rin chen sna bzhi pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ / dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gi lus/ / bla ma bshang dang gci bas mchod/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan pa'i/ khu ba blangs nas mchod par bya/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ /ba dan lda ldi sil snyan sogs/ /rta babs mchog dang bla re dang*/ /bsil g.yab khyams dang khri stan sogs/ /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam shing*/ /nam mkha' mdzod sogs dbul bar bgyi/ /dngos grub thams cad bstsal du gsol/ / gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar de nyid lnga pa dang*/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud kyi bar/ 'dud nyi shu dang*/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'i tshe/ zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cig /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud/ /sa sogs 'byung ba rnam dag cing*/ /byams sogs tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /zag med bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /gti mug dga' ma sogs phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna la sogs rnam dag cing*/

/phar phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid/ /dkyil 'khor mchod la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rdo rje gzugs sogs phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ba'i thibs po rnam bcom pa/ /bsdu dngos bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang mdzad pa'i/ /sgo srung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing*// byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa/ / gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi/ /sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo phyag 'tshal lo/ / ces pa'am long skabs yod cing spro na/ dus gsum rdo rje'i thugs yin srid dang thar gyur gang*/ /zhi zhing sgrib med nam mkha' dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnam rgyas byang chub dbang phyug rdo rje can/ /de la lus ngag yid kyis rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang*/ /rnam par shes dang skye mched drug dang dbang po drug /sa chu me dang rlung dang nam mkha' thams cad ni/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug nyes pa 'dod chags rdo rje chos bcas gang*/ /rig pa'i sbyor ba las byung rtag tu rab 'bring bar/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dga' bas myos pa'i dngos gyur pa/ /byang chub sems= /sdud dang dga' dang rnam par de bzhin mi 'gyur dang*/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin sems su rjes thogs chos/ /rmongs dang zhe sdang 'dod chags sgrib pa rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems 'dra= /gang zhig thog ma med dngos rnam dag 'di sgom pa/ /thabs dang shes rab las byung spros dang rnam par bral/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur brtul zhugs dam tshig sbyor ba brtag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog gi thabs ni 'di bsgoms shing*/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga nye bar bsgrub pa sgrub pa dang*/ /sgrub pa chen pos blo mi 'gyur ba'i sgrub dbang po/

/byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la= / gang zhig thun bzhi'i rdo rje dag ni sgrub byed pa/ /mi snang la sogs sna tshogs mchog dang sman 'grub cing*/ /bla ma'i drin gyis 'di na ma nor lam rtogs pa/ / byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig rab gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud ni nyan pa dang*/ /'don par byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang*/ / mchod pa byed pa dang ni 'bri'am 'brir 'jug pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang du zhi sogs las tshogs shin tu brtags pa yis/ / 'khrul 'khor sngags kyi cho ga de bzhin rgyas 'debs pa'i/ /bsgrub bya 'di dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i dbang po ni/ /byang chub= /gang gis gtso bo sgrub pa po mthong reg pa dang*/ /legs par dran dang ming tsam nges par thos pa dang*/ /dad par byed cing phyogs cig tsam zhig 'dzin pa dag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu rtog pa ma lus spangs/ /dri ma dang bral bdag nyid can/ /kun bzang chos dbyings ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba'i/ /'od zer brgya phrag rnam 'gyed pa/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rnam snang gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ngan rtog pa dang bral zhing*/ /skyon med mkha' ltar rnam par dag /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / rin chen dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag med 'od kyi mkha' kun khyab/ / tshad med yon tan phreng ba yis/ /kun rtog ye shes mkhyen pa yi/ /'od dpag med la= /'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po/ /ji bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur ba yi/ / bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /don yod grub pa de la 'dud/ /sa ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu rnam par 'dzin spyod pa/ /thugs rje spyod pa g.yo ba po/ /lha mo spyan mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu yis sems can rnams/ / nyon mongs nyid ni rab zhi ba/ /chu ltar phan pa don chen gyi/

/mā ma kī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs nyid ni bsreg par brtson/ /bya ba rtse mo mchog grub pa/ /na bza' dkar mor phyag 'tshal lo/ / rlung ltar kun nas nyon mongs pa'i/ /rtsad 'byin 'gro la bde ba stsol/ /ut+pal la yi spyan mnga' ba/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi gzugs ni rgya che zhing*/ /rnam pa kun tu mi 'phro ba/ /rtags bral gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /mnyam med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu yis sgra rnams kyi/ /de nyid rnam pa gsum rgyas shing*/ /rna ba'i bde ba stsol mdzad pa/ /sgra yi rdo rje mar phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi longs spyod lhun grub pa/ /sems can ma lus la sems pa'i/ /bung ba'i sgra mdzad rdo rje dri/ /ma smad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang rig bstan du med/ /gnyis med ro myong stobs kyis su/ /sems can bde la gnas mdzad pa/ /rdo rje ro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji bzhin du ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /re ba gang la sred mtha' ru/ /'gro gsum rtag tu dga' mdzad pa'i/ / reg bya rdo rje mar phyag 'tshal/ /gang phyir kun nas nyon mongs pa/ /gcod pa'i rgyud gyur chos rnams kyis/ /kun la rtag tu rtog mdzad pa/ /bla med chos kyi rdo rjer 'dud/ /gang phyir theg pa chen po la/ /mi rnams dga' ba bskyed mdzad pa/ /dad pa rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /gshin rje gshed por phyag 'tshal lo/ / mkhas pa gang gi stobs kyis su/ /byang chub tshogs rnams rdzogs mdzad pa/ / brtson 'grus rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab mthar byed phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu yis sems can rnams/ /dge ba brjed med bskyed mdzad pa/ /dran pa rnams dag ngo bo nyid/ /pad+ma mthar byed phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi stobs kyis sems can rnams/ /bgegs bral bde la gnas mdzad pa/ /bsam gtan rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /bgegs 'joms mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gsum pa ni/ sgrub thabs su bshad zin to/ /gal te ye shes zhabs lugs las 'byung ba'i/

mi bskyod rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor sogs dkyil 'khor gzhan dang*/ gzhan dag mchod par 'dod pa rnams kyang*/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sngags dang*/ bstod pa bzhag pa tsam gyis/ gzhan rnams mchod chog 'di kho na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rnam snang la sog pa rigs lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor la ni/ rigs lnga'i bstod pa rnams la gong 'og brje ba tsam bya'o/ /'jam rdor gyi bstod pa la mtshan brjod klog pa yang shin tu 'brel zhing*/ bla ma snga ma rnams kyi phyag len la yod par snang bas/ long skabs yod pa'i tshe nan tan du bya ba'i 'os so/ / mchod pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ byis pas rang dgar byas pa yi/ /tshig sbyor mang po rnams spangs te/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i gsung bzhin bkod/ / 'phags bskor la sogs 'dus pa'i lugs/ /kun dang phal cher thun mong ste/ /thun mong min pa'i khyad par yang*/ /mang du yod pa shes par gyis/ /'dir 'bad dge ba nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /ma dag snang ba'i smag rum mun bcom nas/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'gro rnams smin las slar/ /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs rgyal ba'i dbang por gyur/ /ces pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhugs/ - PAGE 170 -- PAGE 171 -- PAGE 168 -
